mapper.select: SELECT a.*, FALSE AS isSet FROM `inspection`.`inspection_check_account_sheet_sub` a WHERE a.`SHEET_ID` = #{params.SHEET_ID}
SELECT a.`SHEET_ID`, a.`SHEET_NAME` FROM `inspection`.`inspection_check_account_sheet` a WHERE a.`TASK_ID` = #{params.TASK_ID} AND a.`SHEET_NAME` = #{params.SHEET_NAME}

SELECT a.`TAX_ORG_ID` AS id, a.`TAX_ORG_DSCR` AS name FROM dmcode.`cm_guoku_taxorg` a WHERE 1=1
AND a.TAX_ORG_ID = #{params.TAX_ORG_ID}

SELECT a.`guoku_id` AS id, a.`guoku_dscr` AS name FROM dmcode.`cm_guoku_dimnsn` a WHERE a.bookorgcode IN ( SELECT ii.`BOOKORG_ID` FROM `inspection`.`inspection_task` ii WHERE ii.`INSPECTION_TASK_ID` = #{params.TASK_ID} )

SELECT a.`SHEET_ID`, a.`SHEET_NAME`, b.realname AS `NAME` FROM `inspection`.`inspection_check_account_sheet` a JOIN `jeecg-boot-os`.`sys_user` b ON a.`ADD_USERID` = b.`id` WHERE a.`TASK_ID` = #{params.TASK_ID}

SELECT a.`SHEET_ID`, a.TASK_ID, a.`SHEET_NAME`, a.DEPARTMENT_HEAD, a.GROUP_LEADER_FT, a.NAME, a.`INSPECTED_GUOKU_ID`, c.`guoku_dscr` AS INSPECTED_GUOKU_DSCR, a.`CHECK_ACCOUNT_ORG_ID`, b.`ACC_DATE`, b.`ACC_CONTENT`, b.`TRE_AMT`, b.`CHECK_ORG_AMT`, b.`DIF_AMT`, b.`REMARKS`, FALSE AS isSet, DATE_FORMAT(a.ADD_DATE, '%Y年%m月%d日') AS ADD_DATE FROM `inspection`.`inspection_check_account_sheet` a LEFT JOIN `inspection`.`inspection_check_account_sheet_sub` b ON a.`SHEET_ID` = b.`SHEET_ID` LEFT JOIN dmcode.`cm_guoku_dimnsn` c ON a.INSPECTED_GUOKU_ID = c.`guoku_id` WHERE a.`SHEET_ID` = #{params.SHEET_ID}
mapper.update: UPDATE `inspection`.`inspection_check_account_sheet` SET SHEET_NAME = #{params.SHEET_NAME}, INSPECTED_GUOKU_ID = #{params.INSPECTED_GUOKU_ID}, CHECK_ACCOUNT_ORG_ID = #{params.CHECK_ACCOUNT_ORG_ID}, DEPARTMENT_HEAD = #{params.DEPARTMENT_HEAD}, GROUP_LEADER_FT = #{params.GROUP_LEADER_FT}, `NAME` = #{params.NAME}, MODIFY_DATE = #{params.MODIFY_DATE} WHERE SHEET_ID = #{params.SHEET_ID}
